Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                        ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OE CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current R.1V14.5 Residential Muhi-Unit District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 5-G in the area bounded by:

       A line 172.00 feet north of West Armitage Avenue; North Dayton Street; the public alley
       next north and parallel to West Armitage Avenue; and the public alley next west of and
       parallel to North Dayton Street

to those of a RT4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 2014 North Dayton Street
